concept: One calm projected console follows Priya's single question from her chat panel into the model's light: it breaks into tokens, the tokens are weighed, the next piece is scored and drawn again and again, and the same reply forks into 30 days and 60 days. Two striking moments (the shatter in b04, the fork in b14), calm briefing frames between them, and the policy sheet that stays outside the window until the payoff.

story.metaphor: following one question through the model's light, piece by piece
story.setting: a quiet operations console projected in light: Priya's assistant chat, and inside it the model's dark space
story.arc: two equally sure answers; inside the model nothing is looked up, pieces are weighed and drawn; the fork explains the two answers; the payoff gives it the source and checks what matters

cast.name: Priya
cast.role: office employee asking the company assistant; shown only as her name tag on the chat panel, never drawn (hologram guide s8: no character kit for this style)

stations.note: inside the chat panel: the model's dark space for sec1

devices.what: Priya's assistant chat as a projected HUD panel (kit part chat_panel): her name tag, the question line, then reply cards; the same panel opens and closes the lesson
the question as indexed glowing pieces on a baseline (H.tokens), held across sec1 while it gains number tags, a window frame and weight arcs

a bracketed frame of light holding question, chat so far and an empty reply line (kit part context_window), with the policy sheet (kit part policy_doc) drifting outside it in b06 and pasted inside it in b21
the ranked column of next-piece candidates (H.bars, bars only, no numbers) beside a growing reply line, held through sec2
the two answer cards 30 days and 60 days (kit part reply_card), equally bright, returning in new states: side by side, forked, unlinked, cracked, matched
join material: the camera pushes through the chat panel into the model (zoom join b03); sections close with a power-down to a line and the next boots from a line (camera b10, cut b16, cut b21)

value_script.why: the console at the desk, a calm open
inside the model: a dark stage for the mechanism, light only on tokens, weights and candidates
back to the briefing register for judgement
the lift at the close: the policy arrives, the rules rest

parts.what: Priya's company assistant chat as a projected hologram panel: a bracketed frame titled 'Company assistant', a small name tag 'Priya' on her side (no person drawn), her question line that types on with a block cursor, two reply slots below it, an input strip at the bottom that can hold an attached document chip

one assistant reply as a card of light: the reply text large (passed in, e.g. '30 days' or '60 days'), both instances equally bright; a link socket at its left edge; a faint crack that can run through its plate while its glow stays steady; an OK tag for a matched reply

Priya's expense policy as a projected sheet: title 'Expense policy', abstract text lines (no readable invented rules or dates), one line that can be lit as the matching line; dim and out of focus when outside the model's reach

the context window as a bracketed frame of light with three labelled bands stacked inside: 'question', 'chat so far', 'reply' (the reply band an empty line until written); a label plate 'context window' on its top edge; a fourth band appears for a pasted document

kit.notes: No person is drawn anywhere: the hologram guide (s8) has no character kit, so Priya is a name tag on chat_panel. Token rows, weight arcs, bars, the dial are engine pieces (H.tokens, H.arcs, H.bars) in the scenes, not kit parts.
